decision_rule: Use target mode only: same-window np4 quarter anchors at start/middle/end and both 4-wave np8 L64k arms must complete; all target streams, binary, model, corpus, placement, cleanup and GPU quiet observations valid. For each metric, anchor-floor = 100*(max-min)/median across the 3 anchor launches. For sum and stream additionally compute range/median for decode waves 1–3 of each target arm; stream value is each wave median of 8. Threshold = max(2*max(anchor-floor, unified range, split range),3%). Wave-0 TTFT uses anchor-floor. Apply PLAN s10 better/no-difference/mixed rule; incomplete or invalid is UNKNOWN/INVALID. Qualification control is excluded. No deployment claim.
